name: clean_keyset_pagination
title: Keyset pagination for the activity feed
body: Adds next_page so the feed can page past the first 50 events without OFFSET. Same order as first_page (created_at DESC, id DESC).
diff:
### feed/pages.py (modified, +10/-0)
@@ -7,3 +7,13 @@
         "ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT %s",
         (user_id, size),
     )
+
+
+def next_page(user_id, last_created_at, last_id, size=50):
+    """The page after the row (last_created_at, last_id): keyset pagination."""
+    return query(
+        "SELECT id, created_at, body FROM events WHERE user_id = %s "
+        "AND (created_at < %s OR (created_at = %s AND id < %s)) "
+        "ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT %s",
+        (user_id, last_created_at, last_created_at, last_id, size),
+    )
